title: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: params, roles, stop/logprobs, streaming formatting and structured output
author: Daniel Kim
release_notes: Adds OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity for params/roles/stop/logprobs and improves streaming formatting and structured output. Backwards-compatible API changes; no customer action required.
description: Motivation: provide parity with OpenAI /v1/chat.completions semantics for parameters, role handling, stop sequences, and logprobs passthrough while improving streaming chunk formatting and structured output tooling. Summary: implements parameter mapping, role normalization, stop token passthrough and multi-stop support, logprobs and token-level metadata passthrough where supported by model backend, and aligns streaming framing to OpenAI-compatible chunk events to improve downstream client compatibility. Includes e2e tests, SDK examples and docs. Checklist: - Implement parameter mapping and validation; - Normalize and preserve message roles (system/user/assistant) across gateway and runtime; - Support stop as string or array and ensure correct termination behavior; - Pass through logprobs and token metadata when available; - Align streaming chunk format to OpenAI event sequence; - Add structured output tests and examples; - Update docs and changelog; - Add Linear/Jira links and tests. Testing: unit tests for serializer/validator, integration tests against compatibility harness, e2e test covering function/tool calls and streaming with simulated backend, manual QA with Python and Typescript SDKs. Migration notes: default behavior unchanged for existing Redwood API users; OpenAI compatibility layer opt-in via /v1/chat.completions endpoint mapping. See docs: docs/openai-compatibility.md and internal Linear ENG-1234 for design.

notes: Backwards compatibility: Redwood default API unchanged; OpenAI mapping only active for /v1/chat.completions endpoint mapping behind feature flag.
Stop parameter: supports string and array; empty array treated as no-op (keeps previous behavior).
Logprobs: passthrough only when backend provides token-level logprobs; otherwise field omitted to avoid breaking clients.
Streaming: event stream uses 'data: {"delta":...}' framing compatible with OpenAI clients; added tests for partial tokens and role deltas.
Structured output: added example for function/tool-calling and schema enforcement; outputs can include 'tool' events in streaming mode.
